verdict.line: You lose extended poke wars if you walk into Malphite's 625-range Seismic Shard before your own Q can reach him; you win the moment Thundering Smash's stun lands and you chain into Frenzied Maul.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Q (Seismic Shard, range 625) outranges Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash, range 300) by more than double, so he can poke you for free while you're closing distance. Your answer is Sky Splitter (E, range 1200), which out-ranges his entire kit and lets you punish him for standing still to cast Q. Once you're actually inside 300 range, the fight flips hard: Thundering Smash's stun plus Frenzied Maul's double-cast heal wins straight trades, which is why the matchup sits at an even 48.4% win rate over 1565 games but with the solo-kill edge on your side.

theirWindow.when: His Q (8s CD) is up, you're outside 300 range
theirWindow.what: He can land Seismic Shard and slow you before you're close enough to threaten Thundering Smash. Don't walk up for no reason here — use a minion to block the shard or throw Sky Splitter (E) at him instead since it reaches 1200 range and he has nothing that far to answer with.

yourWindow.when: You're inside 300 range and his Q is down
yourWindow.what: Thundering Smash (Q) to stun him, then Frenzied Maul (W) twice for the mark-and-heal bonus damage. Granite Shield only absorbs the first hit of the combo if it's recharged, so this trade still wins even if his passive is up.

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards winning the Thundering Smash stun into repeated Frenzied Maul casts — this page runs 45.7% win rate at 29.2% pick, the top choice for this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 67.9% with a 48.2% win rate, giving you a finisher for the all-in once your Q stun lands. Flash+Teleport (45.8%, 19.3% pick) is the alternative if you want to scale and prioritize side-lane pressure instead.

playing.title: Bait Q before you all-in
playing.detail: Granite Shield absorbs your first hit if it's recharged. Throw a W (Frenzied Maul) poke first to strip the shield before committing your full stun-and-burst combo.

playing.title: Don't walk up into his Q range
playing.detail: His Seismic Shard reaches 625, yours (Thundering Smash) only reaches 300. Use minions as cover or hold position until his Q is on cooldown before closing distance.

playing.title: Poke with E, not melee
playing.detail: Sky Splitter reaches 1200 range and shields you if you're inside the blast — use it to chip him down safely instead of trading autos he can punish with Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction.

playing.title: Chain Q into double W
playing.detail: Once Thundering Smash lands the stun, cast Frenzied Maul twice on him immediately — the second cast's bonus damage and heal is what wins the trade outright.

playing.title: Watch for his W toggle
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes boosts his Armor and Attack Damage for a short window — avoid extending trades into it, since his autos output full damage during this period.

playing.title: Hold R for a real engage
playing.detail: Stormbringer's cooldown is 160s at rank 1, dropping to 110s by rank 3 — don't waste it poking, save it for when you can land the slow on him or dive under tower, since it disables nearby towers temporarily.

playing.title: Respect his R past level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force knocks you up from 1000 range — don't overextend past minion waves once he's level 6, since a knock-up into a follow-up kills you before you can react.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Malphite’s (Q) too often. Use [E] to contest lane and [Q] whenever he is in range to gain control over lane.
